en.content:
Arrange the following bonds according to their average bond energies in descending order :
C–Cl, C–Br, C–F, C–I
en.explanation:
Bond length order in carbon halogen bonds are

in the order of C – F C – Cl C – Br C – I

Hence, Bond energy order

C – F C – Cl C – Br C – I
